ways.label: Careys Creek Track, Double Hill Road to Evansdale Glen

start.name: carpark on Double Hill Road
start.quote: the carpark on Double Hill Road

evidence: From the carpark on Double Hill Road, the track will take you to Evansdale Glen/Waimoi.
Alternatively, the track can be walked in the opposite direction from Evansdale Glen.

access_points.name: Evansdale Glen (walking in the opposite direction)

side_trips.name: Honeycomb Track and Rongomai Track Loop
side_trips.quote: Honeycomb Track and Rongomai Track Loop

doubts: The page says the track can also be walked in the opposite direction from Evansdale Glen; recorded as an access point at the end rather than a separate way. The side-trip loop is made of two map tracks (T2 Honeycomb Track, T3 Rongomai track) and so has no single ref; the page does not say exactly where on Careys Creek Track it leaves.
